description: A script for printing and sorting diffs of IDL interface definitions, with colorized output and sorting options by tags or alphabetically.

classes.name: Colorize
classes.description: Outputs colored text to sys.stdout, with support for different colors.

methods.name: sort_member_types
methods.description: Sorts interface members in the order defined by EXTATTRIBUTES_AND_MEMBER_TYPES, preserving diff tags.

methods.name: group_by_tag
methods.description: Groups interface or member list items by diff tags: deleted, added, or unchanged.

methods.name: sort_interface_names_by_tags
methods.description: Sorts interface names based on their diff tags: deleted, added, then others.

methods.name: sort_members_by_tags
methods.description: Sorts members of an interface by diff tags.

methods.name: sort_diff_by_tags
methods.description: Sorts entire interfaces collection by diff tags.

methods.name: sort_members_in_alphabetical_order
methods.description: Sorts interface members alphabetically by name.

methods.name: sort_diff_in_alphabetical_order
methods.description: Sorts entire interfaces collection alphabetically by interface name.

methods.name: print_member_with_color
methods.description: Prints a member with color indicating diff status: added, removed, or unchanged.

methods.name: print_extattributes
methods.description: Prints external attributes of an interface.

methods.name: print_items
methods.description: Prints list items with commas, using a callback for each item.

methods.name: print_extattributes_in_member
methods.description: Prints external attributes within a member.

methods.name: print_diff
methods.description: Prints the entire diff of interfaces with color coding.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, load diff JSON, sort, and print diff.
